name: portal-v2

request.name: portal-v2
request.prompt: Continuous unobstructed nighttime megacity with distant neon high-rise towers, tiny flying vehicles threading between the towers, rain falling outside and subtle reflected colored lights. Realistic atmospheric perspective, coherent city architecture and the source camera viewpoint. Only exterior city scenery is visible in the painted regions.

editReference.name: Edited frame · Edit only the exterior scenery visible through the existing glass pane

sourceOrigin: AI-generated fictional footage and references from job2; no phone capture is claimed.
deliveryDescription: Native1280x720/24fps97-frame output from the normal saved-take CPU recompose route. Original padded native raw and executed generation graph retained.
note: Final whole-window interior includes old dividers, so divider layout changes intentionally. See visual-review.json for actual limits.

nativeGeneration.note: Observed API operation wall time includes preparation and finishing; engine execution time, if separately recorded, is not the same measurement.

finalCPURecomposition.wallSecondsMeasurement: Client admission-to-completion observation; API created/updated span is recorded separately.

observedTiming.note: Successful final stages only. Rejected generation and failed pre-fix CPU attempts are retained privately and excluded from these successful-stage timings.

portability: Import included source and guide media into a target app and rebind local clip/reference IDs in generation-request.json. Generate through /api/renders, then bind that returned renderId in recomposition-request.json and submit /api/recompositions. Paint coordinates are serialized; PNG overlays are review evidence only.
